pri_001: You can recognise it by its unusual height for an oak, 32.5 metres, more like a spruce than a spreading oak. It stands on a slope in Vingio parkas, about 120 metres from the main gate.
pri_003: You can recognise it by its red leaves and the bench and information sign set beneath it. It stands in the garden of the Ieva Simonaitytė Memorial Museum, at Vingio gatvė 11.
pri_004: You can recognise it by its great height, 37 metres, rising out of what now looks like ordinary woodland. It stands about 120 metres along the footpath from the information stand on Parko gatvė.
pri_005: You can recognise it by the signpost at the crossroads marking it as Europinis kėnis. It stands near the end of Parko gatvė, by house number 11.
